gdp.title: Real GDP growth
gdp.transformation: Annual growth of constant-price GDP; World Development Indicators.

inflation.title: Consumer price inflation
inflation.transformation: Annual rate based on the consumer price index; WDI.

unemployment.title: Unemployment rate (ILO estimate)
unemployment.transformation: ILO-modeled unemployment, not the Swiss registered unemployment rate.

current_account.title: Current account balance
current_account.transformation: Current account balance scaled by current-price GDP.

exports.title: Exports of goods and services
exports.transformation: Exports relative to GDP; includes goods and services.

eur_chf.title: EUR/CHF exchange rate
eur_chf.source: European Central Bank · Euro foreign exchange reference rates
eur_chf.transformation: Original ECB CHF per EUR reference quote; a falling value means CHF appreciation against EUR.

usd_chf.title: USD/CHF exchange rate
usd_chf.source: European Central Bank · Euro foreign exchange reference rates
usd_chf.transformation: Derived as (CHF per EUR) / (USD per EUR) on matching dates; a falling value means CHF appreciation against USD.
